lines.l: A rich old man, she won't have to worry
She'll dress up on a lace and go in style
Late at night, a big old house gets lonely
I guess every farm or refuge has its price
And it breaks her heart to think her love is only
Given to a man with hands as cold as ice
So she tells him she must go out for the evening
To comfort an old friend who's feeling down
But he knows where she's going and she's leaving
She is headed for the cheating side of town
You can't hide your lying eyes
And your smile has a thin disguise
I thought by now you'd realize
There ain't no way to hide your lying eyes
On the other side of town
A boy is waiting
With fiery eyes and dreams
No one could see
She thrives on through the night
Anticipating
Cause he makes her feel
The way she used to feel
She rushes to his arms
They fall together
She whispers
That's only for a while
She swears that soon
She'll be coming back forever
She pulls away
She leaves him with a smile
You can't hide
You're lying eyes
And your smile
Is in disguise
A thought by night
I can't realize
There ain't no way to hide your lying eyes
She gets up and pours herself a strong one
And stares at the stars up in the sky
Another night, it's gonna be a long one
She draws a shade
